tools.name: equity_research_brief
tools.description: Use when writing a stock thesis, an investment memo, a watchlist note or answering "is this company any good?". Up to 4 fiscal years of revenue, gross/operating/net margin, free cash flow, R&D, stock comp, buybacks and dividends; growth (YoY, CAGR, margin change, share-count change); latest quarter

tools.name: stock_screen
tools.description: Use for a daily stock screen or to find candidates: rank by quality, growth, op_margin, fcf_margin, roe, net_cash, shrink (biggest share-count reduction), quarter_growth or revenue; filter by min revenue, growth, margins, quality, positive FCF, net cash, exchange; top 1-100. Each row: ticker, revenu

tools.name: portfolio_review
tools.description: Use when someone shares a list of stocks they hold or watch and asks "how healthy is this portfolio?", "what should I look at first?" or "which of these report next?". tickers = comma list (1-25), weights = optional numbers in the same order. Returns per-holding quality score, growth, margins, free

tools.name: stablecoin_report
tools.description: Before holding or accepting one stablecoin in size: 90-day daily and 7-day hourly peg history (worst print, days off peg), supply rank and 1/7/30-day mint and redemption flows, chain split, peers, every risk component explained, plain-English summary. coin = ticker, name or CoinGecko id (default USD

tools.name: stablecoin_risk_board
tools.description: Before parking funds in a stablecoin or as a daily depeg / bank-run monitor: every USD stablecoin above $10M with price, peg deviation (bp), 1d/7d/30d supply change and net flows, mechanism, chains, 0-100 risk score, tier, flags and market-wide alerts. PAID: $0.01 per call, no account. Pay with x402

tools.name: buy_research_pass_day
tools.description: For research sessions: one x402 payment of $1 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 24 hours (up to 40 successful calls; four briefs alone list at $1). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $1.00, no account. Pay with x4

tools.name: buy_research_pass_week
tools.description: One x402 payment of $5 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 7 days (up to 300 successful calls). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $5.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address, the x402-over-MCP retry format, and how to use a Research Pass instead (bought once with x402 or with a plain USDC transfer on Base, no x402 client needed).

tools.name: equity_coverage_check
tools.description: FREE. Whether a company is in the equity universe, its latest fiscal year end and filing dates, before paying for equity_research_brief.

tools.name: pass_quote
tools.description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote and the USDC amount to send on Base to this service. After sending, call pass_claim with the quote and the transaction hash to receive the pass token.

tools.name: pass_claim
tools.description: FREE. After the transfer has landed on Base, returns your lp1.… pass (claiming again returns the same pass). Then set the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"].

tools.name: pass_status
tools.description: FREE. Plan, expiry and calls left on the pass sent as the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer lp1..." (or _meta["lumen/pass"]).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: portfolio_review · Private data: buy_research_pass_day, buy_research_pass_week, pass_quote · Public sink: equity_research_brief, stock_screen, portfolio_review, pass_quote · Destructive: stablecoin_risk_board, payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: portfolio_review · Private data: buy_research_pass_day, buy_research_pass_week, pass_quote · Public sink: equity_research_brief, stock_screen, portfolio_review, pass_quote · Destructive: stablecoin_risk_board, payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
